The '''Devaron system''' was located within the [[Duluur sector/Legends|Duluur sector]] of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]. It was the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]].
